results.title: Anti-thromboinflammation of Triherbal Extract in Diabetic Rats
results.content: **Objective:** To evaluate the effects of a blended aqueous extract of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina on some markers of thromboinflammation in diabetic rats. **Conclusion:** This study revealed that the blended aqueous extracts of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina are non-toxic and may have synergistic effects in limiting thromboinflammation in a diabetic state. doi: 10.1186/s12933-023-01990-6.
